name: cowart-thinking-canvas
description: The official Excalidraw editor with optional Codex Agent generation of native editable diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Official Excalidraw, plus optional AI-generated native editable diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Yogurt AI embeds the official Excalidraw editor and keeps the AI layer completely optional. With AI off, users get the standard Excalidraw tools, style panel, shortcuts, and native document model. With AI on, Codex Agent generates native rectangles with bound text, frames, and bound arrows using html-line-svg layout rules; every generated element stays individually selectable, movable, resizable, restylable, editable, deletable, and reconnectable.
capabilities: Official Excalidraw editor runtime and UI
Native editable cards, frames, text, and bound arrows
Deterministic layout and obstacle-aware arrow routing
